messages:
ava: Quick FYI — our Kotlin SDK sample app is producing duplicate POSTs on Android 13 when a coroutine is cancelled and retried. Pixel 8 emulator repro.

liam: Are you using the raw Call in the suspend adapter? That used to cause double-enqueue when coroutine restarts.

ava: Yep, adapter uses suspendCoroutine + call.enqueue. Logs show two full POST cycles back-to-back.

nina: Fix is to call call.clone() inside adapt and use suspendCancellableCoroutine with cont.invokeOnCancellation { cloned.cancel() }. Also add a unit test with a fake OkHttp client to assert single request.

ava: Tried clone + cancellation hook, ran 500 stress iterations on emulator with orientation changes — duplicates gone. Pushing small PR with sample-app update and a short note in devdocs.

ci-bot: CI run for branch `fix/retrofit-clone` passed all checks.
